title: structured-output: add constrained decoding backends (CFG / regex / tokenizer edge cases)
author: Priya Patel
description: Motivation: we need first-class constrained decoding support for structured-output use cases (CFG/grammar constraints, regex anchors, and robust handling of tokenizer edge cases) that integrates with the OpenAI-compatibility layer and streaming paths. This PR implements two decoding backends (CFG and regex) + a tokenizer-edge-case guard, wires them into the existing constrained-decoding API, updates the OpenAI compatibility 'structured_output' plumbing and function-calling interactions, adds test coverage and examples, and fixes several streaming/backpressure edge cases discovered while integrating.
commits_summary:
1) Initial CFG backend implementation and unit tests
2) Regex constraint backend + pattern precompilation and anchor handling
3) Tokenizer edge-case guard: anchor remapping and deterministic tokenization for constraints
4) OpenAI-compat updates: structured_output parameter passthrough, function-calling interplay fixes
5) Streaming stability fixes: backpressure on streaming encoder and deterministic chunking
6) Docs and examples + end-to-end integration tests
(6 commits, squash on merge)
diff_snippets:
--- a/redwood/serving/decoding/constrained_backends.py
+++ b/redwood/serving/decoding/constrained_backends.py
@@ -1,6 +1,34 @@
+from .cfg_parser import CFGConstraint
+from .regex_backend import RegexConstraint
+from .tokenizer_guards import TokenizerGuard
+
+class ConstrainedBackendFactory:
+    """Factory that chooses/compiles the appropriate backend given constraint config.
+    Supports: cfg (grammar), regex (pattern anchors), and hybrid modes.
+    """
+    ...
--- a/redwood/openai_compat/structured_output.py
+++ b/redwood/openai_compat/structured_output.py
@@ -10,7 +10,19 @@
-def handle_structured_output(req, model):
-    # previous simple passthrough
+def handle_structured_output(req, model, stream=False):
+    """Translate OpenAI-style structured_output/request constraints into internal backends.
+    Ensures tokenization anchors and function_call compatibility is preserved when streaming.
+    """
+    constraints = req.get('structured_output') or req.get('constraints')
+    if not constraints:
+        return None
+    # compile backend using factory so both CFG and regex are supported
+    backend = ConstrainedBackendFactory.compile(constraints, model.tokenizer)
+    return backend

release_notes:
- Add CFG-based constrained decoding backend for structured-output use cases.
- Add regex-based constraint backend with safety checks and anchor semantics.
- Add tokenizer-edge-case guards to ensure deterministic constraint matching across tokenizers (handles BPE splits and unknown tokens).
- Wire structured_output constraints through the OpenAI compatibility layer and streaming paths.
- Streaming stability fixes and deterministic chunking to avoid constraint mismatches during streaming.
- Tests, docs, and examples added.
